billing.subtitle: Subscriptions, unified usage quotas (LLM + Cloud VM), and extra-usage credits for {{workspace}}.

free.name: Free
free.description: $0.50/mo free-tier usage quota (LLMs + 4-core Cloud VMs at $0.16/hr)

plus.name: Plus
plus.description: $10.00/mo quota for Cloud VMs (~200 vCPU-hrs) + $2 Free-Tier LLM allowance · BYOS/BYOK · Max 1 VM (no team)

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: $25.00/mo pooled quota for Cloud VMs (~550 vCPU-hrs) + all LLM models · Up to 4 members

team.name: Team
team.description: $200.00/mo pooled quota across all 16 models & Cloud VMs · Up to 20 members & 20 VMs
